Prepare data for the district tax-rate viewer

txs_viewer_prepare.Rd

Builds the baked data artifacts behind txs_viewer(): statewide tax rates (with the penny decomposition) joined to district boundaries through the NCES crosswalk, written as a wide map table, a tidy long table, and a small metadata file. Composes txs_get_tax_rates(), txs_derive_pennies(), txs_crosswalk(), and txs_boundaries() – the first run downloads several files and takes a few minutes; subsequent runs reuse the cache.

Usage

txs_viewer_prepare(
  years = NULL,
  mcr = NULL,
  boundaries_year = 2023,
  dir = NULL,
  refresh = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

years

Integer vector of ending school years (2024 means 2023-24), or NULL for all available years.

mcr

Optional Maximum Compressed Rate input: a data frame or a CSV path with columns (year or school_year, district or cdn, mcr). NULL leaves the mcr column NA.

boundaries_year

Census TIGER vintage for txs_boundaries().

dir

Output directory; default file.path(txs_cache_dir(), "viewer"), where txs_viewer() looks.

refresh

If TRUE, re-download even if cached.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

Invisibly, a list with dir, paths, and the metadata list.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
txs_viewer_prepare()
txs_viewer()
} # }
